### About Us

SwiftSku is a Y Combinator backed early stage startup. SwiftSku's cofounder, Mit Patel, grew up helping his family run their small convenience store doing all of the pen and paper work ranging from managing inventory and prices to bridging the language barrier between his immigrant parents and vendors. Mit’s family is just one of tens of thousands of immigrant owned convenience stores in the US where more than 85% of independent convenience stores are owned by Indian immigrants. These small mom and pop businesses desperately need our help to stay alive as big chains are gobbling up one family store after another.

SwiftSku not only keeps the mom and pops in business, but helps them to thrive with our complete backoffice ecosystem. Our mobile app and Point of Sale combination makes running their business easy like never before. Our space is not super sexy and has very few tech companies let alone startups. The Opportunity

Ecommerce is going through a structural shift. AI shopping surfaces - ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Amazon Rufus - are changing how products get found and purchased. They don't browse pages. They parse structured data, compare content quality, and recommend based on richness. Products with thin attributes, generic descriptions are invisible.

No traditional PIM does what Merchkit does. No feed tool addresses content quality for LLM retrieval. No competitor is positioned around continuous content optimization for agentic commerce. McKinsey projects $3–5 trillion in global retail revenue from agentic commerce by 2030. Merchkit is the product catalog platform built for that world - and the window to own this category is 12–18 months.

results.text:
About SwiftSku - Revolutionizing C-Store Management

# We help C-Stores to grow their customer base

SwiftSku helps independent c-store owners onboard their c-store with the latest technology to leverage promotional discounts and increase revenue with State of the Art Business Intelligence.

### Empower business to achieve success.

SwiftSku was founded by Mit Patel and Daniel Mazur. Mit and Daniel have extensive experience in the convenience store industry and applying analytics and Business Intelligence to improve industry processes. The SwiftSku team has over 25 years of collective c-store industry experience.

### Mit Patel

Founder & CEO

Mit Patel has been in the c-store industry for most of his life. He has extensive experience in managing convenience stores and creating automation & process improvement software for businesses ranging from c-stores to large enterprises.

### Daniel Mazur

Founder & COO

Daniel Mazur comes from a background of Business Intelligence and Machine Learning. He has worked extensively in the application of BI and AI to improve processes for various businesses. One of his specialties is Blockchain Development, specifically Decentralized Applications
